picks.reasoning: LPL is the clearly stronger region here, and that gap is too big to wave away, so BLG's edge isn't just a hype story. Viper is the kind of carry who decides a single game, and MKOI's comeback habit is a stat I don't trust in a must-win game.

Tempo lives in the first fifteen minutes, and BLG owns that window: they convert leads almost every time they get one, while MKOI keeps having to crawl out of holes they dig for themselves. MKOI's comeback habit is real, but it only matters when the early game goes wrong, and BLG's LPL pedigree tells you they close out the early map better than most teams in this field.

Draft is where this one gets decided, and BLG walks in with a deeper bench of comfort picks, especially on Yunara and Lulu, while MKOI's Ryze and Ezreal habits can be read and punished in a single game. Add Viper's form on the bottom side and the LPL's edge in this matchup, and I'd expect BLG to control the pick phase and the early game.

BLG's 50-12 series record and the LPL's clear edge over the LEC in this matchup give me the call, and MKOI's throws (3 in their last 20) are a real concern if BLG gets an early lead. I'm not going all in, though, because MKOI's comeback habit makes a single game less safe than the series numbers suggest.

Teams win with their heads right now, and BLG's locker room looks settled: they've bounced back from their recent loss and are carrying real momentum into this. MKOI have a knack for coming back from behind, but that's exactly what the LPL's stronger region should make them fight against here.
